paper_metadata.title: Superior cryogenic mechanical properties of Fe-rich medium-entropy alloy with hierarchical heterostructure and phase transformation

evidence.quote: In this work, a hierarchical heterostructure was developed in the Fe60Ni23.5Cr10Al3Ti3Nb0.5 (at%) alloy to achieve exceptional mechanical performance in cryogenic environments.
We propose that the current Fe-rich medium-entropy alloys with uniquely tailored microstructures achieve an excellent synergy between strength and ductility.
